name: Cable TV
old_description: Click on your state to see provider information and find availability in your area
about:
CableTV.us operates from Milton, Delaware, as an online information portal that helps residential and business customers locate cable television, internet, and phone service providers in their area. The company does not state a founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in the available materials. It presents itself as a team of professionals focused on optimizing the user experience for finding and comparing local service options.

The platform aggregates provider data — including package details, channel counts, download speeds, and promotional pricing — from multiple carriers such as Spectrum, Xfinity, Viasat, and others. It does not manufacture, install, or resell any physical products or network services. Instead, it offers a search interface that uses GPS-based location tracking or address entry to return available providers, allowing users to compare plans and access carrier contact numbers for ordering.

The service targets consumers and small businesses seeking home or office connectivity, including TV bundles, broadband internet, and landline phone packages. Examples from the site show it surfaces offers with up to 550+ channels, download speeds up to 1 GIG, and bundle discounts across major national and regional providers. The company explicitly disclaims guaranteed accuracy and notes all logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

CableTV.us says its differentiation lies in GPS-based location identification that aims to return only serviceable results, eliminating the need for users to visit multiple provider websites or enter zip codes that may yield unserviceable addresses. It also emphasizes a consolidated comparison view for bundles, pricing, and features to save users time and money.
